mapper.sql: s.id, s.code, s.name, s.org_unit_id, o.code AS org_unit_code, o.name AS org_unit_name, s.owner_user_id, u.full_name AS owner_name, u.username AS owner_username, s.stage_id, st.name AS stage_name, st.from_year AS stage_from_year, st.to_year AS stage_to_year, s.year, s.status, s.viewport, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM strategy_objective so WHERE so.strategy_id = s.id) AS objective_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM strategy_kpi sk WHERE sk.strategy_id = s.id) AS kpi_count, s.created_by, s.created_at, s.updated_by, s.updated_at, s.version
FROM strategy s JOIN org_unit o ON o.id = s.org_unit_id JOIN app_user u ON u.id = s.owner_user_id JOIN evaluation_stage st ON st.id = s.stage_id
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(code, CHAR_LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) FROM strategy WHERE code LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO strategy (code, name, org_unit_id, owner_user_id, stage_id, year, status, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{orgUnitId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{stageId}, #{year}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE strategy SET name = #{name}, org_unit_id = #{orgUnitId}, owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}, stage_id = #{stageId}, year = #{year}, status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE strategy SET deleted = 1, code = CONCAT(code, '#', id), updated_by = #{by}, updated_at = NOW(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE strategy SET viewport = COALESCE(#{viewport}, viewport), updated_by = #{by}, updated_at = NOW(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, color, sort_order FROM perspective WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 'HIEU_LUC' ORDER BY sort_order, code

SELECT so.objective_id, ob.code, ob.name, ob.description, ob.perspective_id, p.code AS perspective_code, p.name AS perspective_name, p.color AS perspective_color, p.sort_order AS perspective_sort, so.pos_x, so.pos_y FROM strategy_objective so JOIN strategic_objective ob ON ob.id = so.objective_id JOIN perspective p ON p.id = ob.perspective_id WHERE so.strategy_id = #{strategyId} ORDER BY p.sort_order, ob.code
SELECT id, source_objective_id AS source, target_objective_id AS target, source_handle, target_handle FROM strategy_link WHERE strategy_id = #{strategyId} ORDER BY id
SELECT sk.objective_id, sk.kpi_id, k.code AS kpi_code, k.name AS kpi_name FROM strategy_kpi sk JOIN kpi k ON k.id = sk.kpi_id WHERE sk.strategy_id = #{strategyId} ORDER BY k.code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO strategy_objective (strategy_id, objective_id, pos_x, pos_y, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{strategyId}, #{n.objectiveId}, #{n.posX}, #{n.posY}, #{by}, #{by})

INSERT INTO strategy_link (strategy_id, source_objective_id, target_objective_id, source_handle, target_handle, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{strategyId}, #{l.source}, #{l.target}, #{l.sourceHandle}, #{l.targetHandle}, #{by}, #{by})
INSERT INTO strategy_kpi (strategy_id, objective_id, kpi_id, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{strategyId}, #{k.objectiveId}, #{k.kpiId}, #{by}, #{by})
mapper.select: SELECT id, code, status FROM strategic_objective WHERE deleted = 0 AND id IN #{i}
SELECT id FROM kpi WHERE deleted = 0 AND id IN #{i}
